description: This PHP file defines the Returns model class for the OpenCart admin extension. It provides methods to retrieve return records and their total count, with filtering options based on return status, date range, and grouping period.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class for handling return reports, including fetching returns data and total count with filter options.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves return records based on filters such as return status, date range, and grouping period (day, week, month, year). Supports pagination through start and limit parameters.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Calculates the total number of return records matching the specified filters, grouped by day, week, month, or year.
